sources.title: Characterisation of the behaviour of liquefaction triggering in a cyclic undrained simple shear test setting

findings.finding: Reanalysis explicitly identifies EG2018 as17normally consolidated tests without pre-shear, at40/100kPa and approximately70%relative density. Approximate group density is not a specimen-level post-consolidation state or independent measurement.

Authors identify sedimentation, consolidation and height-control execution as sources of uncertainty. The reviewed paper does not supply specimen-level post-consolidation heights, lateral stress measurements, pressure-reference timing or per-file apparatus corrections.

contextual_literature.title: Impact of Compliance on Constant-Height Simple Shear Tests
contextual_literature.review_scope: Publisher abstract and data-availability statement only, reviewed 2026-10-31; no full-text or numerical-data review.
contextual_literature.finding: The abstract distinguishes nominal apparatus height compliance from actual specimen compliance and reports effects on cyclic resistance. This supports requesting apparatus compliance/control documentation; it does not establish the compliance or an applicable correction for the EG2018 specimens.
contextual_literature.data_access: Publisher states data are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. No request made.

remaining_lead_audit.result: A further university-record retrieval timed out; title/identifier searches returned the same university file and author upload rather than an independently readable methods source. Search snippets were not used to assign experimental state.
remaining_lead_audit.boundary: No new specimen-level state or correction convention recovered. A successful thesis retrieval could still provide methods context, but original records or provider clarification remain necessary unless a source explicitly resolves the specimen-level questions.

decisions.response_exposure: Published figures and source text exposed during methods review. No additional raw experiment responses accessed, fitting, scoring or split assignment.
